You have asked what steps to take regarding your Mira vacuum after it displayed the E-7679 error code. Our help article "Recycling your Mira robot vacuum" says that this code means the battery has reached the end of its safe charging life. You must stop using the vacuum, switch it off, and unplug the charging dock. Contact Halvard Home support to see if a battery replacement is suitable before you recycle the unit. Ensure you take the vacuum to a local household waste recycling centre rather than putting it in your household rubbish.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team"}

You have asked about the coverage for a replacement part fitted in your Ashby dryer and whether this affects your overall machine warranty. Our Warranty policy, section "Ashby tumble dryer: Cover period", says the replacement part is covered for 245 days from the date it is fitted. This cover applies only to the part itself and does not restart or extend the original warranty for the whole appliance.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team"}

You asked if you should keep toggling the mains power to try and clear the E-5107 error on your Orrin heat pump following a power cut. Our help article "Power cut during use" says that you should not repeatedly switch the electricity supply off and on. This is because switching the power repeatedly can interrupt the five-minute restart delay required for the compressor.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team"}

You have asked about the correct way to leave the doors of your Vale fridge freezer while you are away for the winter and it is unplugged. Our help article "Using your Vale fridge freezer in a holiday home" says that after cleaning and drying the appliance, you should leave both doors ajar to help prevent smells and mould.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team"}

You asked about the best way to remove stubborn limescale deposits from your Brio kettle filter. Our help article "Cleaning your Brio kettle filter" says that for stubborn build-up, you can soak the filter in warm water for 10 minutes, then brush it gently and rinse thoroughly.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team"}

Our help article "Burning smell from your Orrin heat pump" says you should stop using the heat pump immediately, switch it off at the controller, and then disconnect the power using the labelled isolation switch.

You have asked if you should perform a factory reset after your Lumen thermostat screen went blank during a power cut. Our help article "Lumen smart thermostat: power cut during use" says you should avoid a factory reset as your first troubleshooting step, as it may erase your settings. Once the power returns, wait 5 minutes before checking the thermostat. If the display remains blank after that, please contact Halvard Home support.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team"}

You have asked if you should use sealant to fill the gap because your new Corra hob rocks at one corner. Our help article "Corra induction hob: first installation" says you must not add sealant or press the corner down. You must leave the power switched off and ask your installer to lift the hob and refit the KX-7011 sealing strip correctly.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team"}

You asked how to prepare your old Ashby dryer for collection and whether it is safe to move it alone. Our help article "Recycling your old Ashby tumble dryer" says you should not attempt to lift or move the dryer alone. Before transport, switch it off at the wall, unplug it, allow it to cool, empty the water container, remove any laundry, and secure the power cable.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team"}

You have asked for the cleaning instructions for your Brio kettle, specifically the cooling time required before you start and the frequency for cleaning the air vents. Our Safety and recalls policy, section "Brio kettle: Safe use", says you should let the Brio kettle cool for 36 minutes before cleaning it. Additionally, it says you must clean the air vents every 71 days.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team"}

You asked if you should use washing-up liquid to clean the area around your leaking Tessa dishwasher. Our help article "Water leaking under your Tessa dishwasher" says that you must only use detergent made for dishwashers. Using washing-up liquid can create excessive foam and cause leaks.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team"}

You have asked about the process for cleaning the KX-3452 nozzle because you noticed the water flow from your Vale fridge freezer is slow. Our help article "Descaling your Vale fridge freezer" says you should turn the nozzle anticlockwise to remove it and soak it for 15 minutes in equal parts white vinegar and warm water. After rinsing it thoroughly, refit the nozzle by turning it clockwise, then dispense and discard one litre of water once power is restored.

Kind regards,
The Halvard Home team"}
